title: Who Is Consuming Chinese Tokens?
gist: Teaser only: an unverified claim that over half of China's domestic AI tokens go to video and micro-drama generation has sparked debate contrasting Chinese entertainment-heavy compute use with a supposed US focus on coding and productivity. Gavekal argues that, even with the data unconfirmed, the debate exposes a potential gap between Beijing's economy-wide AI transformation ambitions and the commercial realities of Chinese AI companies, whose video models lead global rankings.

insights.claim: An unverified claim that over half of China's domestic AI tokens are consumed by video and micro-drama generation has sparked heated online debate, with critics contrasting this entertainment use of scarce compute against an alleged US focus on coding and productivity.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: If true, Chinese inference demand is skewed to consumer entertainment rather than enterprise productivity, a different (and possibly lower-margin) revenue base for Chinese AI and compute names.
